src: Library 3D model links. A parametric link has no stored model: its `parametric` spec (a shape and its dimensions in millimetres) is drawn by the viewer, the same way every time. Each link's own `src` cites where the dimensions came from; values marked inferred are typical envelopes, not a standard's figures.

links.name: RJ45 plug — generic detailed approximation
links.src: IEC 60603-7 modular interface: 11.68 mm width, 8 contacts at 1.02 mm pitch. Molex ATS-690081124 revision E describes insulation-piercing blades and primary/secondary strain relief. Height, length, narrow flexible latch, chamfers, clear polymer optics and tapered ribbed boot are inferred generic presentation; not manufacturer CAD or an exact purchased part.

links.name: RJ45 PCB jack — generic detailed approximation
links.src: Molex SD-95501-001 revision F1, 2022-01-10, sheet 1: 8-position unshielded PCB jack envelope 15.24 × 11.50 × 18.10 mm, black LCP housing and gold-finished copper-alloy contacts. Generic depiction inferred from these dimensions, not a Molex CAD replica; PCB tail locations and latch details illustrative, not a footprint. bootLengthMm is an unused compatibility field for the female variant.
